+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1',
+                    'status': ['preview'],
+                    'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = """
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.9"
+author: "Ansible Project"
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Manage syslog hosts, logging destinations, buffered levels and the syslog facility.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or global logging switch.
+    type: str
+    choices: ['on', host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424]
+  name:
+    description: Hostname or IPv4/IPv6 address when C(dest=host).
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a syslog host.
+    type: int
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility. Set to C(user) to restore the default.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Logging severity level, or a list of levels for buffered logging.
+    type: raw
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging settings. Values omitted in an entry inherit top-level values.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+    suboptions:
+      dest:
+        type: str
+        choices: ['on', host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424]
+      name:
+        type: str
+      udp_port:
+        type: int
+      facility:
+        type: str
+      level:
+        type: raw
+      state:
+        type: str
+        choices: [present, absent]
+  state:
+    description: Whether the specified setting should exist.
+    type: str
+    default: present
+    choices: [present, absent]
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare against the running configuration. Can also be set with C(ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG).
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+"""
+
+EXAMPLES = """
+- name: Configure an IPv6 syslog server
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: host
+    name: '2001:db8::10'
+    udp_port: 514
+
+- name: Configure several settings
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {facility: local7}
+      - {dest: host, name: 192.0.2.1, udp_port: 5514}
+      - {dest: buffered, level: [errors, warnings]}
+
+- name: Disable console logging
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: console
+    state: absent
+"""
+
+RETURN = """
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the device.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample: ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::10 udp-port 514']
+"""
+
+import re
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_v6_address
+
+
+LEVELS = ('emergencies', 'alerts', 'critical', 'errors', 'warnings',
+          'notifications', 'informational', 'debugging')
+DESTINATIONS = ('on', 'host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    """Count supplied (including false-valued) fields in a parameter dictionary."""
+    keys = check if param is None else param
+    if isinstance(keys, dict):
+        return sum(value is not None for value in keys.values())
+    if isinstance(keys, str):
+        keys = [keys]
+    return sum(check.get(key) is not None for key in keys)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    for key, value, required in spec or ():
+        if param.get(key) == value:
+            missing = [field for field in required if param.get(field) is None or param.get(field) == '']
+            if missing:
+                module.fail_json(msg="dest=%s requires %s" % (value, ', '.join(missing)))
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for obj in lst:
+        if obj.get('name') == name:
+            return obj
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want or ()) - set(have or ()), set(have or ()) - set(want or ())
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+(?:ipv6\s+)?\S+\s+udp-port\s+(\d+)(?:\s|$)', line)
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+(?:ipv6\s+)?(\S+)', line)
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.match(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+ipv6\s+\S+', line))
+
+
+def _object(dest=None, name=None, udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None,
+            addr6=False, state=None):
+    obj = dict(dest=dest, name=name, udp_port=udp_port, facility=facility,
+               level=level, addr6=addr6)
+    if state is not None:
+        obj['state'] = state
+    return obj
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    params = module.params
+    entries = params.get('aggregate')
+    entries = entries if entries is not None else [params]
+    result = []
+    rules = required_if if required_if is not None else [('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                                          ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    for entry in entries:
+        values = {key: entry.get(key) if entry.get(key) is not None else params.get(key)
+                  for key in ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state')}
+        check_required_if(module, rules, values)
+        dest = values['dest']
+        if count_terms(values, ('dest', 'facility')) == 0:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest or facility is required')
+        if dest not in DESTINATIONS and dest is not None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='unsupported logging destination: %s' % dest)
+        level = values['level']
+        if level is not None:
+            if not isinstance(level, (list, tuple, set)):
+                level = [level]
+            if not level or any(item not in LEVELS for item in level):
+                module.fail_json(msg='level must contain one or more of: %s' % ', '.join(LEVELS))
+            if dest == 'buffered':
+                level = set(level)
+            elif len(level) == 1:
+                level = level[0]
+            else:
+                module.fail_json(msg='only buffered logging accepts multiple levels')
+        if dest not in ('buffered', 'console'):
+            level = None
+        name = values['name'] if dest == 'host' else None
+        if name and ':' in name and not validate_ip_v6_address(name):
+            module.fail_json(msg='invalid IPv6 address: %s' % name)
+        port = str(values['udp_port']) if dest == 'host' and values['udp_port'] is not None else None
+        if port is not None and not 1 <= int(port) <= 65535:
+            module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be between 1 and 65535')
+        result.append(_object(dest, name, port, values['facility'], level,
+                              bool(name and validate_ip_v6_address(name)), values['state']))
+    return result
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    config = get_config(module, None, compare=module.params['check_running_config'])
+    result = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    buffered = set()
+    buffered_disabled = set()
+    buffered_seen = False
+    logging_on = True
+    for raw_line in config.splitlines():
+        line = ' '.join(raw_line.split())
+        if line == 'no logging on':
+            logging_on = False
+        elif line == 'logging on':
+            logging_on = True
+        elif line.startswith('logging host '):
+            result.append(_object('host', parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                                  parse_port(line, 'host'), addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split()[2]
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = set(LEVELS)
+            buffered_seen = True
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered.add(level)
+                buffered_seen = True
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered_disabled.add(level)
+                buffered_seen = True
+        elif line == 'no logging buffered':
+            buffered.clear()
+            buffered_disabled.clear()
+            buffered_seen = True
+        elif line == 'logging console' or line.startswith('logging console '):
+            tokens = line.split()
+            result = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != 'console']
+            result.append(_object('console', level=tokens[2] if len(tokens) > 2 else None))
+        elif line == 'no logging console':
+            result = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != 'console']
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            result = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != 'persistence']
+            result.append(_object('persistence'))
+        elif line == 'no logging persistence':
+            result = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != 'persistence']
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            result = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != 'rfc5424']
+            result.append(_object('rfc5424'))
+        elif line == 'no logging enable rfc5424':
+            result = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != 'rfc5424']
+    result.append(_object(facility=facility))
+    if buffered_seen:
+        result.append(_object('buffered', level=buffered - buffered_disabled))
+    if logging_on:
+        result.append(_object('on'))
+    return result
+
+
+def _host_command(entry, negate=False):
+    command = 'logging host '
+    if entry.get('addr6'):
+        command += 'ipv6 '
+    command += entry['name']
+    if entry.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port %s' % entry['udp_port']
+    return ('no ' if negate else '') + command
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    have = list(have)
+    commands = []
+    hosts = [item for item in have if item['dest'] == 'host']
+    buffered = next((item for item in have if item['dest'] == 'buffered'), None)
+    current_levels = set(buffered['level']) if buffered else set()
+    current_facility = next((item['facility'] for item in have if item['facility'] is not None), 'user')
+    current_on = any(item['dest'] == 'on' for item in have)
+    for entry in want:
+        dest = entry['dest']
+        state = entry['state']
+        facility = entry['facility']
+        if facility is not None:
+            if state == 'present' and facility != current_facility:
+                command = 'no logging facility' if facility == 'user' else 'logging facility %s' % facility
+                commands.append(command)
+                current_facility = facility
+            elif state == 'absent' and facility == current_facility and current_facility != 'user':
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+                current_facility = 'user'
+        if dest is None:
+            continue
+        if dest == 'host':
+            found = search_obj_in_list(entry['name'], hosts)
+            same_name = ([item for item in hosts
+                          if item['name'] == entry['name'] and item['addr6'] == entry['addr6']]
+                         if found else [])
+            if state == 'absent':
+                matches = [item for item in same_name
+                           if entry['udp_port'] is None or item['udp_port'] == entry['udp_port']]
+                for item in matches:
+                    commands.append(_host_command(item, negate=True))
+                    hosts.remove(item)
+            elif not any(item['udp_port'] == entry['udp_port'] for item in same_name):
+                commands.append(_host_command(entry))
+                hosts.append(entry)
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            levels = entry['level'] or set()
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, current_levels)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in adds:
+                        commands.append('logging buffered %s' % level)
+                current_levels.update(adds)
+            else:
+                _, removes = diff_in_list(current_levels - levels, current_levels)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in removes:
+                        commands.append('no logging buffered %s' % level)
+                current_levels.difference_update(removes)
+        elif dest == 'on':
+            if state == 'present' and not current_on:
+                commands.append('logging on')
+                current_on = True
+            elif state == 'absent' and current_on:
+                commands.append('no logging on')
+                current_on = False
+        else:
+            current = next((item for item in have if item['dest'] == dest), None)
+            base = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging %s' % dest
+            if state == 'present':
+                if current is None or (dest == 'console' and entry['level'] is not None and
+                                       current['level'] != entry['level']):
+                    commands.append(base + (' %s' % entry['level'] if dest == 'console' and entry['level'] else ''))
+                    if current is not None:
+                        have.remove(current)
+                    have.append(entry)
+            elif current is not None and (dest != 'console' or entry['level'] is None or
+                                           entry['level'] == current['level']):
+                commands.append('no ' + base + (' %s' % entry['level'] if dest == 'console' and entry['level'] else ''))
+                have.remove(current)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS),
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='raw'),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'], default='present'),
+    )
+    aggregate_spec = dict(element_spec)
+    aggregate_spec['state'] = dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'])
+    argument_spec = dict(element_spec)
+    argument_spec.update(
+        aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+        check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                  fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])),
+    )
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import os
+
+from units.compat.mock import patch
+from ansible.modules.network.icx import icx_logging
+from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
+from .icx_module import TestICXModule
+
+
+class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
+    module = icx_logging
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.get_config_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
+        self.get_config = self.get_config_patch.start()
+        self.get_config.return_value = ''
+        self.load_config_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')
+        self.load_config = self.load_config_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.get_config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_config_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_facility_and_hosts(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging facility local3\nlogging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(facility='local7'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=514, state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=5514),
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=514),
+        ]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, sort=False, commands=[
+            'logging facility local7',
+            'no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+            'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 5514',
+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514',
+        ])
+
+    def test_remove_ipv6_host_uses_discovered_port(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514'])
+
+    def test_host_port_is_part_of_identity(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=514, state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_additional_port_preserves_existing_destination(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=5514))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 5514'])
+
+    def test_buffered_levels_use_positive_and_negative_lines(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered\nno logging buffered debugging\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='warnings', state='absent'),
+        ]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, sort=False, commands=[
+            'logging buffered debugging', 'no logging buffered warnings'])
+
+    def test_facility_clear_and_global_disables(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging facility local7\nlogging console\nlogging enable rfc5424\nlogging persistence\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(facility='local7', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='console', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='on', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='rfc5424', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='persistence', state='absent'),
+        ]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, sort=False, commands=[
+            'no logging facility', 'no logging console', 'no logging on',
+            'no logging enable rfc5424', 'no logging persistence'])
+
+    def test_repeated_settings_are_idempotent(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = ('logging facility local7\nlogging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514\n'
+                                        'logging buffered\nno logging buffered debugging\nlogging enable rfc5424\n')
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(facility='local7'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=514),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='warnings'),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='rfc5424'),
+        ]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_check_mode_and_compare_parameter(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.4', check_running_config=False,
+                             _ansible_check_mode=True))

+        self.get_config.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(self.get_config.call_args[1]['compare'], False)
+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_required_parameters_and_invalid_ipv6(self):
+        for args in (dict(dest='host'), dict(dest='buffered'),
+                     dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='host', name='2001:bad:::1')])):
+            set_module_args(args)
+            self.execute_module(failed=True)
+
+    def test_disabled_lines_are_idempotent(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = ('logging console\nno logging console\n'
+                                        'logging on\nno logging on\n'
+                                        'logging enable rfc5424\nno logging enable rfc5424\n')
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='console', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='on', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='rfc5424', state='absent'),
+        ]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_environment_fallback_for_compare(self):
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {'ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG': 'False'}):
+            set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.4'))
+            self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host 192.0.2.4'])
+        self.assertEqual(self.get_config.call_args[1]['compare'], False)
+
+    def test_parsers_accept_ipv6_and_port(self):
